description: This file defines a React functional component called TenantBootstrap, which manages tenant context initialization during routing. It interacts with several utility functions to determine tenant status, performs conditional redirects based on tenant data, and avoids multiple invocations using React refs. The component is used in a frontend React project to ensure proper tenant context setup after login or page load.

methods.name: TenantBootstrap()
methods.description: React component that initializes tenant context and handles navigation based on tenant data.
